column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.50.
# WHY v1.0.50 EXISTS
# v1.0.49 was TAGGED (d38f3320 -> a612a480) AND NEVER INSTALLED. Zero of the
# seven #550 merges are ancestors of that tag, and the public download is still
# v1.0.41 from 2026-08-22. So this is not an increment on a walked build; it is
# the first artefact that can carry the multi-account store-auth work to a box.
# WHAT FORCED IT BEYOND THAT, and it is the reason this cut is not optional:
# the FIRST EVER box walk of install.sh, on a fresh macOS user account on
# 2026-08-28, DIED IN UNDER THREE MINUTES. It wrote its diagnostics to a fixed
# /tmp path, could not open the redirect because another account already owned
# it, and then printed THAT account's three-day-old pip error to the operator as
# the cause. Pip never ran. bash aborts a command whose redirection cannot be
# opened, so a step that never executed was reported as a step that FAILED.
# THE DISPOSITION OF v1.0.49's ROWS, STATED NOT ASSUMED:
#   * cm051 c1bd50ff (installer_app_bytecode_seeded_before_reseal) -- LANDED
#     AND HELD. Not carried. Its capability stays required in the manifest as a
#     regression guard.
#   * cm051 installer_version_is_the_cut -- 🔴 NOT CARRIED FORWARD AS `yes`,
#     AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE POINT. v1.0.49's row says landed=no and
#     it STAYS no: the capability is "the installer plist version IS the tag
#     being cut", the plist now reads 1.0.50, so `yes` would be FALSE for
#     v1.0.49. Retro-flipping it would launder a version that never shipped
#     into one that did. v1.0.50 gets its OWN row below, which is a genuinely
#     different claim and is genuinely `yes`.
#   * HR015 email-ingest jetsam risk -- CARRIED, unchanged, still NOT A CUT
#     BLOCKER by its own text, still capability_id=none and therefore still
#     UNGUARDED. Its status was NOT re-measured for this cut and nobody should
#     read its presence here as a fresh observation. Carried honestly rather
#     than quietly dropped, because a fresh BOM that omits an open row is
#     laundering with extra steps.
# 🔴 THE SOURCE THIS BOM WAS AUTHORED FROM WAS ALMOST THE WRONG ONE.
# scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh reads a LOCAL OS003 checkout and verifies only that it
# is ON `main` -- never that `main` is CURRENT. The operator checkout was at
# d8bda24 with cuts/ stopping at v1.0.46, and 1,626 of its files were iCloud
# DATALESS placeholders. Its refusal message is identical for "the BOM does not
# exist" and "your checkout is behind", so both were read as one fact and this
# BOM was one step from being authored against a source three cuts stale.
# Caught by @TNM, who read the REMOTE: v1.0.47/48/49 MUST_CONTAIN.tsv are 4401,
# 3851 and 6627 bytes on origin/main c100f169. Re-measured independently, byte
# counts agree, and v1.0.50 genuinely 404s with a negative control that also
# 404s. Authored from a fresh clone: 0 dataless files, all five cut dirs.
# FOLLOW-UP OWED (not during assembly): sync_cut_bom.sh needs a freshness limb
# emitting a DISTINCT CANNOT-RUN, so a stale checkout can never again be
# reported as a missing BOM.
# 🟠 A STALE STRING THIS CUT DOES NOT FIX, NAMED SO THE WALK IS NOT A SURPRISE.
# install.sh:11711 now reads `${OSTLER_STORE_AUTH_ENFORCE:-1}` -- the #1222 flip
# landed, enforcement defaults ON. But install.sh:11751, the else-branch message,
# still says "staged but DEFAULT-OFF ... Set OSTLER_STORE_AUTH_ENFORCE=1 once
# the client-side auth PRs land." The operative default is correct; only the
# explanatory string describes the world before the flip. Same class as the
# v1.0.49 daemon ack that named the wrong cause. Not a cut blocker: it fires
# only when someone sets ENFORCE=0 deliberately.
# 🟢 THE TWO NEW CAPABILITY ROWS LAND IN THIS SAME CHANGE, which bom_add.sh
# explicitly calls a legitimate order of work, and BOTH were mutation-tested
# against the unfixed file before being written:
#     install_diagnostics_are_private_per_run  present  2 here / 0 unfixed
#     install_has_no_shared_tmp_pip_sink       absent   0 here / 7 unfixed
# TWO SURFACES, AND NEITHER IS CLAIMED TO BE THE OTHER. Presence cannot catch a
# regression that ADDS a shared sink back while leaving the mktemp line; absence
# of one pattern cannot prove all 34 are gone. The COUNT half is
# tests/test_diag_sink_per_run.sh arm 1, wired into CM051 CI, whose own arm 7 is
# a live control proving the old shape still fails closed on the runner.
what

🔴 THE DEFECT THAT KILLED THE FIRST EVER BOX WALK, IN UNDER THREE MINUTES. install.sh wrote diagnostics to 34 distinct FIXED /tmp paths. On a fresh second account another user already owned them, bash could not open the redirect, and the handler printed THAT user's three-day-old pip log as the cause. Pip never ran. FIX (CM051 #1230): a private per-run mktemp -d sink, plus a self-healing default inside the aiconv leg which runs standalone under `set -u` and so cannot inherit the export. The heal does NOT stop at `:=` -- if mktemp fails the substitution yields empty, `:=` assigns empty, `set -u` is then perfectly satisfied and the redirect target silently becomes a bare path, so a non-empty AND is-a-directory check refuses to run instead. MEASURED ABSENT FROM MAIN THE DAY THIS WAS AUTHORED, with the predicate derived from the diff rather than invented: 34 sinks, ALL present, 60+ occurrences, counts varying 1/2/3/4/7 so the predicate discriminates; positive control 17 shebangs / 1407 OSTLER on the same file. After the merge 60+ -> 1, and the 1 is a comment. 🟢 THE PR REVIVES ORPHAN #1207, WHICH WAS CLOSED WITH NO SUCCESSOR -- `gh pr list --state all --search "910 in:title"` returns exactly one row, itself -- so this fix sat on one disk while the walk it would have saved failed. I blocked #1207 myself; both my blocking findings were cleared by RUNNING them: the aiconv honesty guard went 34 failures -> `checks run: 50, failures: 0`, both G: assertions passing for the right reason, `unbound variable` count 0.

🔴 THE REASON THIS CUT EXISTS AT ALL: the #550 multi-account store exposure reaching an artefact for the FIRST TIME. On real hardware 2026-08-28 an unprivileged second account read the knowledge graph with one curl and no credential. The client+server halves landed across CM051 #1214 #1218 #1220 #1219 #1221 #1222 #1223, and #1222 is the flip: `${OSTLER_STORE_AUTH_ENFORCE:-1}` at install.sh:11711, default ON. ⛔ SOURCE-COMPLETE IS NOT DEMONSTRATED AND THIS ROW MUST NOT BE READ AS CLOSURE. `landed=yes` here means the code is IN THIS ARTEFACT, which is the first of the three gates and not the third. The exposure is shut when the curl is re-run from a second account on a box carrying THIS DMG and returns refused -- same box, same probe, same account, both sides. Until that walk happens the mechanism is proven and the artefact is not. That walk is what this cut is FOR.

🟠 THE INSTALLER MUST BE ABLE TO NAME ITSELF, and for v1.0.50 it can. v1.0.49's row for this capability is landed=no and STAYS no -- see the header; retro-flipping it would launder a version that never shipped. This is a NEW claim about a NEW version. VERIFIED THROUGH THE PARSER, NEVER FROM FILE TEXT, because that is the whole lesson of the v1.0.39/v1.0.43/v1.0.49 refusals: `plutil -extract CFBundleShortVersionString raw` returns 1.0.50 and `CFBundleVersion` returns 5000. CONTROL THAT THE HISTORICAL RECORD SURVIVED: `1.0.49` still appears in 2 files under gui/ (the ORM pin notes and measurement comments a naive sed over gui/ would have destroyed), against `1.0.50` in 3.

🟠 NOT A CUT BLOCKER, BUT A JETSAM RISK ON THE MINIMUM-SPEC BOX. CARRIED UNCHANGED FROM v1.0.48 AND v1.0.49 AND NOT RE-MEASURED FOR THIS CUT. email-ingest holds ~11.5 GB for a ~14-minute tick, every ~70 minutes, on a 16 GB Mac mini, and one observed tick emitted ZERO messages while doing it. Same precondition that killed the Colima VM. Also reopens #870: a tick started 15:42:55 on 23 Aug never logged a finish, 31 minutes before the first jetsam, and that jetsam report's own largestProcess is VTDecoderXPCService, so the recorded chain (installer buffer -> jetsam -> Colima) is at best incomplete. STILL capability_id=none, therefore STILL UNGUARDED and able to regress silently. It is carried because dropping an open row from a fresh BOM is laundering with extra steps.

🔴 TNM FOUND THIS ROW MISSING AND IT IS THE COUPLING TO THE ROW ABOVE. The wiki-compiler credential chain rides v1.0.50 and was unrecorded: CM051 #1228 (installer passes the Qdrant key into the compiler env), CM044 #261 = tag v0.1.28 = 161213ef (compiler sends it), and #1229 which MOVED THE IMAGE PIN 2f02b761 -> 7777e35e. All three are ahead of the v1.0.50 ref, so they are in this cut, not merely on main. WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN MOST: store_auth_enforce_defaults_on, the row this cut exists for, is EXACTLY what makes a missing credential bite. Enforce ON plus no key means the compiler 401s on every Qdrant read, and the failure is SILENT rather than loud. A capability whose failure mode is silence is the one that most needs a capability_id, because nobody will catch it by looking. TNM measured the absence under 18 spellings with controls (diagnostics=3 proves the predicate can see rows, zzz_absent=0); A2 independently REPRODUCED the 401 rather than only reading source. MEASURED BY ARCHIE 2026-08-29 against the real pre-fix specimen 67b142e8~1, not a line deleted by hand: pattern present 1 in origin/main 06beb157 and 0 in the unfixed file, with the control marker wiki-compiler: present 1/1 in BOTH arms, so the zero is real absence and not a broken read. Same measurement re-derived the pin move independently of TNM. ⚠ THIS ROW IS A PRESENCE CLAIM ABOUT THE ARTEFACT, NOT A CLAIM THAT THE WIKI COMPILES FAT. That is a box-walk observation and it has not been made.
